_comment: karverktyg config — everything EXCEPT the API keys (those live in apikeys.conf). Safe to commit and share: it holds no secrets. Fields not set here fall back to defaults or to the environment; the API keys are read from the environment only.
_comment_mode: fixture = demo (no keys/db) · read_only = live, no writes · read_write = live writes (the uppflyttning apply path).
_comment_cohort_year: Uppflyttning year N. Leave it out to derive from the live term (guarded).
_comment_entity_id: The kår's id (also the HTTP Basic username for the API). Not a secret.
_comment_kar: The kår itself: a display name and the avdelningar. Each avdelning has a bracket (sparare/upptackare/aventyrare/utmanare/rover/annat), an optional weekday (0=Mon..6=Sun, drives the same-weekday move), and an optional target (force a specific move destination). Brackets are national and defined in code; troop ids and the group id are read live from the data. With no avdelningar declared the tool infers them from the member data.
